Brief: Tell me about Alan Turing and elaborate on the impact of his work. — about Universal Turing machine

1. In computer science, a universal Turing machine (UTM) is a Turing machine capable of computing any computable sequence, as described by Alan Turing in his seminal paper "On Computable Numbers, with an Application to the Entscheidungsproblem".
2. Or, in other words, a Turing machine that is capable of simulating any other specialized Turing machines.
3. Common sense might say that a universal machine is impossible, but Turing proves that it is possible.
4. Turing introduced the idea of such a machine in 1936–1937.
